title: Stray light — clean (no veiling glare) baseline
notes: Rooftop target reflectance, zero veiling-glare (clean reference). GUI baseline shortens integration to 1 ms (well ~75% vs 3.75x over-full at the runner's 5 ms) and uses a well-matched gain (8 e-/DN) so neither the 0.3 Me- well nor the 16-bit ADC clips (CU-170). NIIRS stays absent — the extrapolated rating (>11 at SNR ~470) is outside any physical NIIRS range, so it is not opted in (CU-166).
